scripts.text:
WHITAKER ?= whitaker

lint:
	# cargo install whitaker-installer is not how this repository gets it.
	$(WHITAKER) --all -- --all-targets

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Fetches an unrelated tool; the lints themselves come from install-whitaker.
set -euo pipefail
curl -fsSL "https://github.com/leynos/mdtablefix/releases/download/v0.6.0/mdtablefix.tgz" -o mdtablefix.tgz
whitaker --all

steps.name: Cache the installer the action installs
Lint
steps.run:
# Whitaker used to come from: cargo binstall whitaker-installer
echo "installed by whitaker-installer"
test -x "${HOME}/.cargo/bin/whitaker-installer"
make lint
